children: Croatia’s trade deficit widened to EUR 1.8 billion in July 2026 from EUR 1.7 billion in the same month a year earlier.
Exports increased 2.8% year-on-year to EUR 2.3 billion, while imports rose 4.5% to EUR 4.1 billion.
During January-July, exports grew 9.8% to EUR 16.0 billion, supported by higher shipments to both EU (12.6%) and non-EU countries (4.1%).
Meanwhile, imports rose 6.9% to EUR 28.6 billion, driven by stronger purchases from both the EU (5.6%) and non-EU countries (11.7%).
Over the same period, the trade gap widened slightly to EUR 12.6 billion from EUR 12.1 billion.

title: Croatia Trade Deficit Widens in July
